candidates.change_summary: Change owner() to return address(0) instead of the stored _owner, causing a different returned owner value.
Change the require preventing zero-address new owner to allow transferring ownership to zero address (removes the require), so transferOwnership(address(0)) succeeds and owner becomes zero address.
Add an extra require making only non-zero newOwner allowed (redundant check moved to after onlyOwner) — identical to original behavior but enforces again; this does not change behavior so omitted.

Invert the onlyOwner check to require caller is NOT owner, so only non-owner can call owner-only functions; this changes who can call transferOwnership and thus alters transferOwnership observable behavior.
